source.name: Tanzil Quran metadata (classification and revelation order)

period.heading: Period of Revelation
period.text: Although Dahhak and Kalbi regard Surah Quraysh as a Madani Surah, a great majority of the commentators are agreed that it is Makki, and a manifest evidence of this are the words Rabba hadh-al-Bait (Lord of this House) in this Surah itself.

source.name: Sayyid Abul A'la Mawdudi, Tafhim al-Qur'an (introduction to the surah)

theme.heading: Theme and Substance
theme.text: As all this was well known in the time of the Holy Prophet's appointment to Prophethood, there was no need to mention it in the Surah.

source.name: Sayyid Abul A'la Mawdudi, Tafhim al-Qur'an (introduction to the surah)
